summary: Silvaco Group, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement to register 69,062 shares of common stock issued as consideration for the acquisition of Tech-X Corporation. The shares are being issued directly to former Tech-X equity holder John Cary without an underwriter, comprising contingent earnout consideration tied to developmental milestones and a portion of post-closing purchase price adjustments in lieu of cash. No cash proceeds will be received by the registrant. The filing is a routine shelf takedown to register shares for issuance under a previously disclosed acquisition, not a standalone special-situation event. The acquisition itself is not the subject of this filing.
